cohort: 358 women in their third trimester of pregnancy who were older than 18 years, having a history of previous cesarean section(s), and not having major physical or mental health problems
finding: Re-pregnant women after cesarean section in China had moderate fear of childbirth, and the number of cesarean sections, experience with previous cesarean section, childbirth self-efficacy and social support were predictors of fear of childbirth.
